# Introducing Cricut Rewards: Get Rewarded for Your Creativity


-
-
-


27 October 2026


[Cricut](https://cricut.com/blog/author/cricut/)


---


From that “I did it” feeling you get when you make your first project to the look on someone’s face when you give them a gift that says, “I get you,” making with Cricut has its rewards. And now, there’s one more.


Introducing Cricut Rewards, our free loyalty program in the U.S. and Canada where members earn points for shopping cricut.com, then redeem rewards to save on future purchases.*


## How it works


### 1. Enroll automatically


After making an eligible purchase on cricut.com (U.S. or Canadian sites only), you’ll automatically start earning points — there are no extra steps to join.


### 2. Shop and earn points


Earn 1 point for every $1 dollar spent on eligible purchases.*


### 3. Redeem rewards


Every 100 points earns $5 additional toward your Cricut Rewards balance to redeem on a future cricut.com purchase (max $50 reward per purchase).


## Never miss a chance to save


When you have a reward available, we’ll let you know. It will show up in your cart and you simply select the reward to apply it to your eligible order. Unused points expire after 12 months, so be sure to earn or redeem to avoid expiration. Don’t worry, we’ll send reminders before your points or rewards expire. Check your points and available reward anytime in your[My Account](https://myaccount.cricut.com/) summary.


[Learn more](https://cricut.com/en-us/cricut-rewards) about Cricut Rewards and see how you can start earning points today!


---


*Cricut Rewards is available only to Cricut account holders in the U.S. and Canada and is subject to the[Cricut Rewards Terms](https://cricut.com/legal) available at[cricut.com/legal](https://cricut.com/legal) . Points are earned on eligible physical products purchased on cricut.com while signed in, after discounts and rewards and before taxes and shipping. Exclusions apply, including subscriptions, digital content, and store credit. Rewards must be used in full on a single order, and any unused amount is forfeited. Points expire after 12 months without earning or redeeming. Delete your Cricut Rewards account anytime in[My Account](https://myaccount.cricut.com/) ; deleting Cricut Rewards permanently forfeits all points and rewards but does not otherwise delete your Cricut Account. Canadian members earn and redeem in CAD. California residents: see our[Notice of Financial Incentive](https://cricut.com/privacy) .
